subject.title: Manage Claw cron jobs through the gateway

question: Should the experimental Claws stack sponsor Gateway-managed cron ownership as an independently landable slice after its export dependency is accepted, or should it remain paused with the broader lifecycle design?
rationale: The patch is a substantial new persisted lifecycle capability, not a repair to an established public contract; the protected maintainer label and unmerged stack require an explicit product and landing-order choice.

options.title: Sponsor the cron slice after its base
options.body: Approve this as the scheduler-ownership stage once the export base lands and the current head supplies live Gateway proof.

options.title: Pause the stack for broader design review
options.body: Keep the branch open but defer merge until maintainers decide the complete Claw ownership and upgrade model.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the cron slice after its base
recommendation.body: Approve this as the scheduler-ownership stage once the export base lands and the current head supplies live Gateway proof.

likelyOwner.reason: He is assigned to the PR and already defined the central agent-deletion and cron-lifecycle invariants.
